app.bannedNote: An admin has revoked access to this account. If you think this is a mistake, reach out to whoever runs this arena.
app.appealLabel: Tell us why this should be reviewed
app.appealPending: Your appeal is in — we'll review it and lift the ban if it's approved.
app.appealDenied: Your last appeal was denied. You can send another one below.
auth.displayNamePlaceholder: how you appear in the arena
auth.mismatch: Those two passwords do not match.
auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm, then sign in.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
lobby.playNote: Ranked, Vs Friends, or Vs Bots
lobby.rankedNote: Play for a place on the ladder
lobby.friendsNote: Open a room, or join one
lobby.spectateNote: Look in on a live match
lobby.adminNote: Cards, sounds, the menu, and everyone's account
ranked.searching: Looking for an opponent… {seconds}s · {waiting} in the queue
ranked.fussy: The first minute looks for someone close to you. After that it stops being fussy, so a wide gap still finds a game.
ranked.noDeck: You have not picked a deck, so you will field {deck}.
bot.blurb: It brings five random cards and plays by exactly the rules you do. Nothing here touches your rating.
bot.calmNote: Plays roughly. Walks into counters and will let you take a free hit.
bot.sharpNote: Plays properly. Trades when the trade is good and rarely wastes a turn.
bot.ruthlessNote: Counts what comes back, and will not stand where you can reach it.
friends.openRoomNote: You get a five-letter code. Send it to whoever you want to play.
friends.noRating: Nothing you play here touches anybody's rating. That is what Ranked is for.
friends.noFriendsYet: No friends yet. Search for a username below.
friends.inviteComingSoon: Battle Royale invites are not wired up yet.
friends.orPlayAStranger: Or play someone who is not a friend yet
notif.title: Notifications
kingdom.deleteBody: The cards go back to the roster. Nothing else about your account changes, and you can build it again whenever you like.
kingdom.confirmLeaveTitle: There are unsaved changes, are you sure you want to go to the lobby?
kingdom.noCrown: no crown, and a kingdom needs exactly one
kingdom.twoCrowns: two crowns, and a kingdom takes exactly one
kingdom.hasRetired: one of these has left the roster
ladder.empty: Nobody has finished a ranked match yet.
ladder.note: Only the ranked queue moves this number. It rises and falls by how strong your opponent looked on paper: beating someone far above you gains a lot, beating a beginner gains little, and losing costs exactly what you would have gained.
match.confirmLobby: Are you sure you want to go to the lobby? The bot match will end.
match.sendCode: Send this code to your opponent
match.goesLeft: {left} of {cap} left. One go is one unit's move and strike together.
match.pickToRead: Pick a unit to read it
match.awayNotice: {name} has not acted for three turns. If they have dropped, the match is yours.
match.stalemateDraw: Stalemate -- neither side landed a blow for five straight rounds. It's a draw.
match.forfeited: {name} forfeited by going AFK for two turns running.
match.lockedIn: Locked in. It starts when they are ready too.
match.deployHint: Pick a unit, then a lit tile. Drop on your own to swap.
match.bothPlacing: Both sides are placing their units.
match.confirmResign: Are you sure you want to forfeit?
match.noGoesLeft: No goes left. End your turn.
match.pickThenMenu: Pick a unit, then choose from its menu. {left} of {cap} {word} left.
match.spectating: Spectating — you can chat, but the board isn't yours.
match.rematchBot: Starts a fresh board against the same opponent.
match.rematchAsked: It starts the moment they accept. Sides swap.
match.rematchDeclined: They passed on the last one. You can ask again.
match.confirmLeaveDeploy: Leave now? It counts as a loss and costs you RP.
settings.cineNote: The full-screen retelling of a fight. The board's own animations stay either way.
ladder.cupsNote: Tournaments won. Nobody has any yet — tournaments are still being built.
board.defendNote: Halves what lands on this unit until its next turn.
board.burning: Burning: loses 15% of its maximum HP whenever it strikes
board.poisoned: Poisoned: loses 10% of its maximum HP at the start of its turn
board.stunned: Stunned: cannot strike or use its ability on its next turn
board.swamped: In the swamp: cannot use its passive or its ability
board.guarding: Guard up: halves what lands on it until its next turn
throw.choose: The gale has {name} — choose where to throw them
duel.title: Battle
duel.noteFire: Fire stays on whatever it touches.
duel.noteVenom: Poison takes a tenth of a maximum every turn, for good.
duel.noteGuard: halved again by the raised guard
duel.noteQuick: Quick Dagger — the answer lands before the blow it answers.
duel.noteParryAll: Always Ready — Lium catches the answer as well as the blow.
duel.noteMend: A mend is not an exchange — no crit, no parry, nothing comes back.
duel.noteBurn: Burning costs you every time you swing.
duel.noteSteal: A cursed body takes back part of what it deals.
chat.title: Chat
log.title: Battle log
settings.title: Settings
settings.musicNote: Menu and battle playlists, set by an admin
settings.reduceMotionNote: Menu transitions only — the board still animates
settings.themeNote: Light, dark, or whatever your device says
settings.languageNote: The interface. Card names never change.
profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.nameRules: 2 to 20 characters. Letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores.
comics.failed: The comics could not be loaded right now.
tree.name: Tree
tree.note: Anyone can cut it down. Wuzu simply steps over it.
wall.note: A cursed wall. Solid until it's destroyed -- nobody walks through it, and nothing shoots over it.
bomb.note: A hidden trap. Whoever steps on it takes damage, then it's gone.
tornado.note: A tornado. It can be thrown to hurl whoever it catches.
tourney.nobodyYet: Nobody has signed up yet. Be the first.
tourney.needThree: The countdown starts when a third player joins.
tourney.blurb: Single elimination, seeded by RP. Byes go to the top seeds. Your rank is not at stake — only the cup is.
tourney.yourMatchIsOn: Your match is waiting for you.
tourney.waitingNext: You are through. Waiting on the other match.
tourney.knockedOut: You are out of this one. You can still watch it finish.
tourney.watchingOnly: You are not in this one — sign-ups open again when it ends.
tourney.nextOneIsOpen: Sign-ups for the next one are already open.
board.abilitySwamped: It is standing in the swamp — no passives, no abilities.
board.abilityPassive: This one carries a passive, not an ability.
board.moveAlreadyMoved: This unit has already moved this turn.
board.actSpent: This unit has already used its turn.
board.moveNoSpace: No open tile to move to.
board.actAlreadyActed: This unit has already acted this turn.
board.abilityNoSpace: No empty space available to place this object.
board.abilityStructureActive: A structure is already active on the board. You must wait for it to be destroyed before placing another.
board.friendlyFireConfirm: Are you sure you want to attack your own unit?

royale.title: Battle Royale
royale.openRoomNote: Up to four seats. Invite friends or share the code.
royale.waitForHost: Waiting for the host to start.
royale.waitingForThem: Waiting on the rest of the table…
royale.deployHint: Tap a unit, then tap a tile in your own corner to move it there.
royale.stalemateDraw: Stalemate -- nobody landed a blow for five straight rounds. The battle is a draw.
royale.forfeitWinnerIs: {name} wins -- their last opponent forfeited by going AFK.
royale.vsBotsNote: Face 1-3 bots at once. Nothing here touches your rating.
